records.text: Maple Collective is a week in with no project yet, worth a nudge at this point

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Maple Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Your workspace for Maple Collective is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:cd1eb9e0, email:3d9847e8). No tickets or any signal of engagement, so no evidence of momentum; 8 days left means unaided activation is possible but unlikely on current silence.

draft.subject: One quick step to get Maple Collective moving
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Checking in after your first week with Wrenfield. The best starting point is still one real project -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so everything else builds from there. If it helps, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to sit with you while you set up that first project and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
